g.text: Rocket-equation model of the simulated vehicle; LEO requirement calibrated to the trajectory simulation (expendable 23.2 t, droneship 19.1 t, RTLS 15.6 t to 200 km);
higher orbits add impulsive Δv from a 200 km parking orbit; inclination changes the Earth-rotation gain (465 m/s × cos i), no dog-legs; booster reserves held at their LEO values.
